app.pageTitle: Octop - Understands you, helps you, grows with you

hero.title_trail: an AI partner that grows with you
hero.subtitle: More than a tool — a digital companion that works in parallel. Built for individuals and teams, it makes collaboration efficient, flexible and easy to extend.

float.local_desc: Chats, files and keys stay on your own machine

install.title: Ready in three steps
install.desc: No need to set up a complex environment first. Copy the command below and run it — Octop prepares everything it needs.

hints.script: Best for trying Octop out on your own machine.
hints.pip: Already have Python? Install straight from PyPI.
hints.docker: Best for servers — the container ships with its own runtime.

why.desc: Not another chat box. It lives on your own machine and knows your people, your tools and your computer — so it can actually get things done for you.

multi_user.title: Deploy once, everyone gets an assistant
multi_user.desc: One service on one machine, and every person gets an assistant that only remembers their own things. Call in an analyst for the weekly report, a researcher for digging — swap the role, keep the setup.

connectors.title: Plugs into accounts you already use
connectors.desc: Tencent Docs, Tencent Meeting, Notion, mail — authorize once, then just say "put today's meeting takeaways in the doc". No more copy-paste round trips.

coding.title: Teams up with your editor and terminal
coding.desc: It won't fight the Cursor and CLI you already live in: heavy changes go to dedicated coding agents over ACP, and you only review the result.

computer.title: It really knows how to drive a computer
computer.desc: Running commands, clicking through pages, filling forms, grabbing a screenshot as proof — you name the goal, it does the moving and only comes back when it's stuck.

desktop_pet.title: Keep one on your desktop
desktop_pet.desc: Ask the moment a thought shows up — no window switching, no waiting for a browser. The rest of the time it just idles in the corner of your screen.

pet.title: A desktop companion, always nearby
pet.desc: The floating pet stays on your desktop and answers on demand — capture an idea the moment it appears, no browser required.

faq.title: Questions & help
faq.desc: Find answers about Octop and how everything works.

open_source.a: Yes. Octop is fully open source under the MIT license, so you are free to use, modify and redistribute it.

storage.a: Everything stays on your own machine, by default under ~/.octop. Chat history, workspace files and credentials are never uploaded to a third party.

skills.q: How do I add new skills?
skills.a: Install a skill package from the Skills page in the dashboard, or drop a skill folder into the assistant workspace — it is loaded on the next start.

multi_user.a: Yes. A single deployment can host multiple users and roles, each with their own assistants, workspace and permissions.

commercial.q: Is there a commercial or cloud edition?
commercial.a: We currently offer two options: the open source edition, and a Tencent Cloud Lighthouse quick-create image.

os.a: macOS, Linux and Windows — or any container-capable server via Docker.
